fair_value_reason: 50/50 blend, as all five use. EV/EBITDA: 6.0x x ~$19.9B Oct-27 NTM adj. EBITDA = ~$119B, less ~$62.4B net debt (now including ~$1.4B of JV commitments), over ~625M shares = ~$91. DCF: ~$5, the reconciled floored split mean of $3.7 plus a little option value that a cell-level floor leaves out. Blend ~$48, vs the agents' mean $47.7 and $50 in round 3. The drop is the JV commitments and the slightly lower site-built NTM EBITDA.
supervisor_summary: In round 4 all five rebuilt their DCFs site by site and split the discount rate. On one basis (Oct-27, rent inside operating cash flow, each agent's own grid), the floored split DCFs run $0-8.9 a share (mean $3.7; single rate mean $3.2), and the central cells run -$74 to -$23. Agent_2's high value came from a 25% weight on k 2.1x and was not supported by fleet capex per MW, while its 9.25% lease rate pushed the other way. The site coverage errors I found (Niagara outside the 4.2 GW, agent_5's self-builds counted twice) and the rate anchors are each worth under $1. The split rate adds only ~$3 unfloored because signed cash is 0-4 years out by Oct-27. Reconciled fair value is ~$48 against $88.57 spot. I keep the forecasters' mean ladder (P>=89 0.39), and the name stays a small satellite at most for a portfolio already in GOOGL, AVGO and VST.
key_drivers: Capex intensity k: fleet ~2.6x ($40.7B in-service gross PP&E over ~1.5 GW = ~$27M/MW against ~$10.3M/MW of revenue). Each 0.1x is ~$11-13 a share unfloored. Refresh is ~0.85k (85% of in-service PP&E is technology and software, 10-Q).
Economic life and re-contract regime: 6->7 yrs is +$30-43, and shortage vs glut is ~$40. Current rents are firm (H100 ~$2.77 on Oct 1), so this is not tested before 2028.

Delivery of ~2.4 GW of contracted-not-energized capacity, ~0.75 GW of it unnamed: >3 GW active at YE27 needs ~0.25 GW of unnamed capacity in 2027, after Helios II slipped a year and Poolside's 250 MW was terminated.

Leverage and rent: ~$62B Oct-27 net debt including JV commitments, plus a $16.3B lease liability (12-yr remaining) that runs whether or not slots are refilled. The split rate adds only ~$3 a share unfloored because signed cash is 0-4 yrs out by Oct-27.

The 12-month price follows ~6x NTM adj. EBITDA (~$19.9B) and AI-capex sentiment. Concentration (Customer A 36% of Q2) and dilution (35M-share ATM, 2033 converts at $97.85) are the near-term overhangs.
